title: Elf Bar Elfx Dual Mesh Replacement Vape Pods 2ml - 3 Pods
description: The Elf Bar Elfx Dual Mesh Refillable Pods are engineered to deliver a superior vaping experience, pairing advanced coil technology with a user-friendly design. Available in two resistance options, 0.6Ohm and 0.8Ohm, these refillable pods cater to a variety of vaping styles and e-liquid preferences. Each pod is equipped with advanced dual mesh coil technology, optimised for consistent vapour production and bold, authentic flavour. The 0.6Ohm pod is ideal for Restricted Direct-to-Lung (RDL) vaping, offering smooth vapour and excellent compatibility with 50/50 and Nic Salt e-liquids. The 0.8Ohm pod is perfect for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vaping, providing a more intense, tactile draw and compatibility with 50/50, High-PG, and Nic Salt e-liquids. With a 2ml refillable capacity, these pods feature a mess-free side-fill system and a 4-layer anti-leak design, ensuring hassle-free use and reliable performance. Designed exclusively for the Elf Bar Elfx Pro Classic Edition Pod Kit, the pods are TPD-compliant and come in packs of three for added convenience. Whether you prefer smooth RDL vaping or a rich MTL experience, the Elf Bar Elfx Dual Mesh Refillable Pods offer a premium solution for vapers of all levels. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
